name: Aadhaar Card — New Enrolment & Update
summary: Apply for a new Aadhaar number or update your name, address, mobile, photo or biometrics through the UIDAI portal or your nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra.
whoNeedsThis: People who changed name after marriage
Anyone shifted to a new address
documents: Proof of Identity (PAN, Voter ID, Passport, School ID)
Proof of Address (Electricity bill, Rent agreement, Bank passbook)
Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate, 10th marksheet)

steps.title: Open the UIDAI portal
steps.detail: Visit uidai.gov.in and choose 'Book an Appointment' under My Aadhaar.
steps.tip: Use Chrome or Edge for best compatibility.

steps.title: Select city & Aadhaar Seva Kendra
steps.detail: Pick the nearest center. Avoid month-end Saturdays — they are usually crowded.

steps.title: Fill applicant details
steps.detail: Enter mobile, name (as on documents), gender, DOB, address. Spelling must match supporting documents exactly.
steps.tip: Even a single missing initial can cause rejection.

steps.title: Verify OTP
steps.detail: Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to your mobile to lock the appointment slot.

steps.title: Pay the fee online (for updates)
steps.detail: ₹50 for demographic updates, ₹100 for biometric updates. Save the receipt PDF.

steps.title: Visit the center on the chosen date
steps.detail: Carry original documents + printout of the appointment slip. Biometrics will be captured (photo, fingerprint, iris).

steps.title: Collect the acknowledgement (URN)
steps.detail: Note the 14-digit Update Request Number. Track status at myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in.

commonMistakes: Mismatching name spelling between Aadhaar form and ID proof
Using a mobile number you no longer own — OTPs will fail later
Submitting expired address proofs (older than 3 months for utility bills)

faq.q: How long does an Aadhaar update take?
faq.a: Usually 7–30 days. You can track it using the URN on the UIDAI portal.

faq.q: Can I update Aadhaar online without visiting?
faq.a: Yes — address can be updated online with a valid address proof. Biometrics and photo require a visit.

name: PAN Card — Form 49A (New / Reprint)
summary: Apply for a new PAN card or reprint a lost one using NSDL (Protean) Form 49A. Required for bank accounts, salary, ITR and high-value transactions.
whoNeedsThis: Students opening their first bank account
documents: Proof of Date of Birth (Birth certificate / 10th marksheet)

steps.title: Visit NSDL / Protean portal
steps.detail: Go to onlineservices.nsdl.com → 'Apply Online' → Form 49A for Indian citizens.

steps.title: Choose application type
steps.detail: Select 'New PAN — Indian Citizen (Form 49A)' and 'Individual' as category.

steps.title: Fill personal details
steps.detail: Name MUST exactly match Aadhaar — no abbreviations, no extra spaces.
steps.tip: Father's name is mandatory even for married women.

steps.title: Enter Aadhaar number
steps.detail: Tick the e-KYC + e-Sign option to skip physical document submission.

steps.title: Add address & contact
steps.detail: Use a permanent address. Email and mobile must be active — OTPs are sent there.

steps.title: Choose AO Code
steps.detail: Use the auto-suggest by entering your city + 'salaried/non-salaried'. AO code is your tax jurisdiction.

steps.title: Upload photo & signature
steps.detail: Photo 213×213 px, signature 213×106 px, both under 100 KB in JPEG.

steps.title: Pay the fee
steps.detail: ₹107 via UPI / Debit Card / Net Banking. Save the receipt.

steps.title: Aadhaar e-Sign
steps.detail: Verify via OTP on Aadhaar-linked mobile to e-sign the application.

steps.title: Note the 15-digit acknowledgement
steps.detail: PAN is allotted in 7–15 days and emailed as e-PAN. Physical card arrives in ~3 weeks.

commonMistakes: Name spelling mismatch with Aadhaar — leads to rejection
Uploading a selfie instead of a passport-style photo
Selecting the wrong AO code (causes future ITR routing issues)

faq.a: Yes, the digitally signed e-PAN PDF is legally valid for all purposes including banking and ITR.

faq.q: What if my PAN is lost?
faq.a: Apply for a 'Reprint of PAN' on the same NSDL portal for ₹50. Your PAN number stays the same.

name: Indian Passport — Fresh / Re-issue
summary: Apply for a fresh passport or re-issue an expiring one through Passport Seva. Includes booking an appointment at the nearest PSK / POPSK.
whoNeedsThis: Anyone needing change of name, address or appearance

steps.title: Register on Passport Seva
steps.detail: Create an account at passportindia.gov.in with a strong password.

steps.title: Login and start a new application
steps.detail: Choose 'Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue of Passport'.

steps.title: Fill the form online or download
steps.detail: Online filling is recommended — auto-saves and validates fields.

steps.title: Enter applicant details
steps.detail: Fill name, family, address, references exactly as on Aadhaar.
steps.tip: References should be neighbours, not relatives.

steps.title: Pay and schedule appointment
steps.detail: Pay fee online and book a slot at the nearest Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or POPSK.

steps.title: Print Application Receipt (ARN)
steps.detail: Take printout + originals + photocopies to the PSK on the appointment date.

steps.title: Visit the PSK in 3 stages
steps.detail: Token → Counter A (verification) → Counter B (police info) → Counter C (granting officer).

steps.title: Police verification at home
steps.detail: Local police will visit within 14 days. Keep address proof and 2 photos ready.

steps.title: Passport dispatched by Speed Post
steps.detail: Typically 15–30 days for normal, 3–7 days for tatkal.

commonMistakes: Mismatched name across Aadhaar and 10th marksheet
Choosing references who live far away
Not carrying originals to the PSK appointment

faq.a: PSK is the main passport office. POPSK is a smaller centre run from a post office — same service, often less crowded.

faq.q: Can a minor get a passport?
faq.a: Yes — both parents must sign Annexure D and accompany the child to the PSK.

name: Voter ID — Form 6 (New EPIC)
summary: Register as a new voter and get your EPIC card through the National Voters' Service Portal. Required to vote in Lok Sabha & Assembly elections.
whoNeedsThis: People who shifted to a new constituency
documents: Proof of ordinary residence (rent agreement / utility bill)

steps.title: Visit voters.eci.gov.in
steps.detail: Sign up with your mobile and verify OTP.

steps.title: Select Form 6
steps.detail: Choose 'Fill Form 6 — New Voter Registration'.

steps.title: Choose state and constituency
steps.detail: Pick the state, district, and Assembly Constituency where you ordinarily reside.

steps.title: Fill personal & family details
steps.detail: Name, DOB, gender, relative's name (father/mother/spouse). Use Aadhaar spelling.

steps.title: Upload photo & documents
steps.detail: Photo under 2 MB. Birth/age proof and address proof as PDF/JPG.

steps.title: Declaration & submit
steps.detail: Tick the citizenship and address declaration, then submit.

steps.title: Track using reference number
steps.detail: BLO will verify your address in 2–4 weeks. EPIC is dispatched by post and digital e-EPIC is downloadable.

commonMistakes: Applying in two constituencies — leads to rejection of both
Forgetting to add Aadhaar (now mandatory under Form 6B)

faq.q: Is Aadhaar mandatory for voter ID?
faq.a: It is now collected via Form 6B, but voter registration cannot be denied for not having Aadhaar.
Yes — after approval, download the digitally signed e-EPIC PDF from the same portal.

name: Ration Card — NFSA Application
summary: Apply for an APL / BPL / AAY ration card under the National Food Security Act to access subsidised foodgrains at your Fair Price Shop.
whoNeedsThis: Families below the income threshold of their state
Newly married couples splitting from a joint card
Migrant workers (One Nation One Ration Card)
documents: Proof of residence (electricity bill / rent agreement)
Passport-size photo of head of family

steps.title: Visit your state's Food & Civil Supplies portal
steps.detail: Examples: epds.bihar.gov.in, fcs.up.gov.in, ahara.kar.nic.in.

steps.title: Create login with mobile + OTP
steps.detail: Save the credentials — needed for renewals and member additions.

steps.title: Choose application type
steps.detail: Select APL / BPL / AAY based on your annual family income.

steps.title: Fill head-of-family details
steps.detail: Name, Aadhaar, gender, mobile, bank account (for DBT).

steps.title: Add each family member
steps.detail: Aadhaar, age, relationship. Children under 5 don't need biometrics.

steps.title: Upload documents
steps.detail: Income certificate is the most rejected — make sure it's recent (within 6 months).

steps.title: Pay nominal fee and submit
steps.detail: Note the application reference number.

steps.title: Field verification
steps.detail: An inspector visits within 30 days. Keep originals ready at home.

steps.title: Download e-Ration Card
steps.detail: Once approved, download from the same portal and laminate it.

commonMistakes: Listing a member who is already on another family's card
Wrong category (APL vs BPL) leading to ineligibility for free grains

faq.q: What is One Nation One Ration Card?
faq.a: Migrants can collect grains from any Fair Price Shop in India using the same Aadhaar-linked card.

faq.q: How do I add a newborn?
faq.a: Use the 'Add Member' option after the child has a birth certificate and Aadhaar.

name: Driving Licence — Learner & Permanent (Form 2 / 4)
summary: Apply for a Learner's Licence and then a Permanent Driving Licence via Parivahan Sarathi. Includes online test slot booking.

steps.title: Go to parivahan.gov.in/sarathiservice
steps.detail: Choose your state and click 'Apply for Learner Licence'.

steps.title: Aadhaar e-KYC
steps.detail: Enter Aadhaar number, get OTP, fetch demographic details automatically.

steps.title: Fill applicant details & vehicle class
steps.detail: MCWG (gear bike), LMV (car), MCWOG (scooter ≤50cc) etc.

steps.title: Upload photo, signature & docs
steps.detail: JPEG under 200 KB each.

steps.title: Pay fee online
steps.detail: ₹200 for LL. Receipt is generated instantly.

steps.title: Book LL test slot
steps.detail: Online slot at your RTO. The test is a 10-question rules quiz — practice on the Sarathi mock test.

steps.title: Take the LL test
steps.detail: Pass with 6/10. LL is issued the same day as a downloadable PDF.

steps.title: After 30 days, apply for permanent DL
steps.detail: Login again → Apply for DL → Choose slot for driving test.

steps.title: Driving test at RTO
steps.detail: Bring your own / driving school vehicle. 8-figure test for two-wheelers, parallel parking & H-test for cars.

steps.title: DL printed & couriered
steps.detail: Smart card DL reaches you in 15–20 days.

commonMistakes: Booking the LL test the same day — slot needed in advance
Forgetting Form 1A medical certificate for 40+ applicants
Wrong vehicle class — can't switch easily without re-application

faq.a: Yes if you can drive. But many RTOs prefer accredited driving school certificates for first-timers.
6 months. You must apply for DL within this window.
